qualities.name: Attentiveness
qualities.description: Showing attention to detail, understanding complicated information, and discovering what someone is trying to hide.

qualities.name: Duplicity
qualities.description: Lying, convincing while unconvinced, and supporting while internally unsupportive.

qualities.name: Dynamism
qualities.description: Aggressing, dominating, taking action, and using force to get your point across.

qualities.name: Empathy
qualities.description: Relating to other people, expressing concern, finding weaknesses, and connecting.

qualities.name: Initiative
qualities.description: Forward thinking, moving quickly, and handling things before they become a problem.

qualities.name: Persistence
qualities.description: Refusing to back down, putting pressure on, overwhelming and irritating into action.

qualities.name: Presence
qualities.description: Standing out in a room, commanding a group, inspiring and intimidating.

qualities.name: Professionalism
qualities.description: Showing poise under pressure, resisting distraction, interrupting mind-altering effects.

qualities.name: Subtlety
qualities.description: Working quietly, avoiding unnecessary attention, and performing actions with careful precision.
